description: Binds a consulting skill to its LlmMatrix task_type + output_format contract. Decouples skill methodology from provider identity.

skill_id.description: Skill file name without extension, e.g. "adopt-consulting-partner".

output_format.description: Expected OutputFormat of this skill's primary deliverable.

provider_constraints.description: Explicit ProviderId list if the skill REQUIRES specific capabilities (multimodal, etc.). Empty = any.

harvest_to_graph.description: If true, skill output MUST be persisted as a WorkArtifact+BOMItem in the graph.
